screen.boldtextfix.efficiency.tooltip: Limited: limits bold glyph generation speed to help reduce stuttering during continuous generation. Full speed: no generation speed limit; faster, but more likely to cause stuttering.
screen.boldtextfix.notifications.tooltip: Shows the glyph generation progress panel. Hiding the panel does not affect generation.
notification.boldtextfix.dilation.summar:

notification.boldtextfix.dilation.errors: %s characters failed; their original glyphs are retained.
screen.boldtextfix.mode.custom_font.tool: Use your selected TTF/OTF file to render bold text.
screen.boldtextfix.mode.cycle: Use the left “<” button or the right “>” button to switch bold rendering methods.
screen.boldtextfix.font.size.tooltip: Controls the custom bold font's logical size. Small values can be hard to read; large values may cause overlap or extend beyond text boxes.
screen.boldtextfix.font.oversample.toolt: Controls the rendering clarity of the custom bold font. Low values look blurry; high values increase resource usage.
screen.boldtextfix.font.import_hint: Place TTF/OTF files in config/boldtextfix/boldfonts, or drag them into this screen. Each file can be up to 128MiB. If a font is in the folder but not listed, click the refresh icon on the right to update the list.
screen.boldtextfix.font.imported: Successfully imported font file(s): %s. Use the buttons in the top-right corner to switch to “%s” and configure your font.
screen.boldtextfix.font.folder_error: Cannot access the bold font folder. Check its permissions.
screen.boldtextfix.font.selected: Using %s for bold text. Characters: %s. Glyphs: %s.
screen.boldtextfix.font.empty: Drag a .ttf or .otf file into this screen.
screen.boldtextfix.font.file_info: File size: %sMiB. Characters: %s. Glyphs: %s. Used only for bold text; regular text is unchanged.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.boldtextf: Fixes bold-text ghosting and provides adjustable bold rendering.
screen.boldtextfix.mode.dilation.tooltip: Expands glyph outlines evenly outward to make them bold.
screen.boldtextfix.slider.dilation.toolt: Higher strength makes text bolder; at 0px, only the font's original weight is shown. Rendering each bold character for the first time uses a small amount of processing power; later uses reuse the cache.
screen.boldtextfix.slider.offset.tooltip: Higher strength makes text bolder, but values that are too high cause ghosting. At 0px, only the font's original weight is shown.
screen.boldtextfix.preview.label: Preview & help
screen.boldtextfix.preview.missing_glyph: If Minecraft's default font appears in the preview: 1. The bold font file or font resource pack lacks the character. 2. No bold font file or font resource pack is selected. 3. The selected bold font file or font resource pack has a problem.
screen.boldtextfix.font.invalid: This file has a problem and may not load as a font!
